meta.name: ai-baoyu-image-cards
meta.description: 图文卡片生成助手适合内容创作者、市场营销、运营、内容媒体在用户提出“卡片图好读吗”这类问题，需要快速拆解目标、判断重点并形成可执行结果时使用，帮助基于输入材料生成视觉/创意诊断、提示词或分镜方案、发布规格检查。

copy.tagline: 根据输入材料生成图文卡片的设计方案与发布检查
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需快速将内容转化为视觉卡片并确保发布规格正确
copy.tagline_en: Generate visual card designs and publishing checks from input materials
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to quickly turn content into visual cards and verify publishing specs

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会变成图文卡片生成助手。它能根据你提供的目标、素材或链接，输出视觉/创意诊断、提示词或分镜方案，以及发布规格检查。
howto.when: 当你提出“卡片图好读吗”这类问题，或需要快速拆解目标、判断重点并形成可执行结果时触发。

say.text: 这张卡片图好读吗？帮我检查一下。
say.note: Claude 会分析可读性并给出诊断。

say.text: 帮我生成一个产品宣传卡片的提示词。
say.note: Claude 会输出提示词或分镜方案。

say.text: 检查这个设计稿是否符合发布规格。
say.note: Claude 会进行发布规格检查。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude becomes an image card assistant. It can output visual/creative diagnosis, prompt or storyboard, and publishing spec check based on your goal, materials, or links.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask questions like 'Is this card easy to read?' or need to quickly break down goals, judge key points, and form actionable results.

say_en.text: Is this card easy to read? Please check it.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze readability and give diagnosis.

say_en.text: Generate a prompt for a product promotion card.
say_en.note: Claude will output prompt or storyboard.

say_en.text: Check if this design meets publishing specs.
say_en.note: Claude will perform publishing spec check.
